hug-video-generator-free 1.0.0

- Launch of skill to generate AI-animated hug videos from user photos/images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC).
- Handles files up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 files in about 30–90 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Flexible workflows: upload, edit, and export hug videos with quick feedback.
- Integrated credits tracking, error messaging, and session management for a smooth experience.
- Guides users with prompts, concrete instructions, and an intuitive timeline summary.
